completion:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2. Fill in the following information:
- Date of the inspection, time it was completed, number of miles driven in the test round trip
3. Using the provided template, describe "Failed Brake Test" in detail. Be sure to mention:
- What kind of brake test was performed and why it failed.
- What part(s) failed.
- If there were any issues with access, noise or vibrations. 
4. Be sure to include all observations, even if the vehicle passed overall.
5. If applicable, include a description of any unit that gave a "false positive" on an antenna.
